children: UK whisky maker's H1 revenue fell 5% yr/yr, driven by lower trade cask sales
Branded business revenue grew 7%, offsetting declines in non-branded sales
EBITDA loss narrowed slightly, with improved cash generation from branded businesses
Company expects to meet FY26 market expectations of £24.0 mln revenue and £1.7 mln EBITDA
Company says full-year outcome depends on completion of anticipated trade cask sales
Artisanal Spirits sees continued branded business growth and US revenue momentum in H2
BRANDED BUSINESS GROWTH - Co said branded business revenue rose 7% yr/yr, driven by positive momentum and increased member engagement
US MARKET STRATEGY - Co said strategic changes to US route-to-market led to improved sales and reported revenue, with US revenue up 18% yr/yr
TRADE CASK SALES DECLINE - Co said lower trade cask sales were due to timing differences, with expectation for increased sales in H2
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the distillers & wineries peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Artisanal Spirits Company PLC is GBp75.00, about 219.1% above its September 15 closing price of GBp23.50
Sept 14 - Sazerac acquires Au Vodka for more than £300 million, source says
Sept 15 - UK's Wickes Group H1 revenue rises 2.1%, profit up 1.1%
